name: heterogeneous nuclear ribonucleoprotein K

function.text: HNRNPK encodes heterogeneous nuclear ribonucleoprotein K. Annotated molecular activities include cadherin binding and mRNA binding. It participates in signal transduction and mRNA splicing, via spliceosome.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to neurodevelopmental disorder-craniofacial dysmorphism-cardiac defect-hip dysplasia syndrome (autosomal dominant); Au-Kline syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
